_handoff.scope: Public-workflow pass for the default Bengaluru scenario: an already registered birth and certificate copy.
_handoff.observationNote: Unauthenticated, read-only observation of the public Bengaluru Smart City birth/death lookup page. Birth was selected, then the registration-number search control was opened without entering a registration number or date of birth. No login, OTP, CAPTCHA, upload, payment, submission, case lookup, or certificate download was attempted. The legacy BBMP citizen-services URL visibly returned a connection-refused error. This handoff stops at the identifier boundary.

meta.title: Bengaluru birth certificate public workflow — registered copy
meta.disclaimer: Independent research, not official advice. Only public controls, visible failure text, and published support/recovery routes are recorded; do not submit personal data through this ledger.

scenarios.label: Already registered birth — certificate copy
scenarios.summary: An unauthenticated citizen starts at the public Birth & Death lookup and seeks a copy of an existing birth record.

sources.title: Birth & Death Certificate Details — public lookup
sources.notes: Direct public page observation. The page footer identifies Bengaluru Smart City Limited/BenSCL, shows Version 1.3, and exposes the Birth Certificate selector and search controls before any identifier is entered.

sources.title: Contact Us — Bengaluru Smart City Limited
sources.notes: Public contact page lists the BenSCL office, phone 080-22200080, and email bsclnodal@gmail.com. This is a published support route, not a guarantee of birth-record resolution.

sources.title: FAQ'S — One City One Portal
sources.notes: Public FAQ says citizens use the portal's interfaces/widgets by clicking the relevant service and that the portal is free. It contains no birth-specific no-record or lookup-error remedy.

sources.title: BBMP Citizen Services — Birth & Death Certificate
sources.notes: Direct browser navigation showed the visible error text: “This site can't be reached”; “site.bbmp.gov.in refused to connect”; “ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED”. The page was not used to infer a working form.

claims.text: The public SmartNet Birth & Death Certificate Details page initially exposes a certificate-type selector with the options “--Select--”, “Birth Certificate”, and “Death Certificate”.
claims.notes: Observed while unauthenticated; selecting Birth Certificate did not transmit personal data.

claims.text: After Birth Certificate is selected, the public page exposes a Search by selector with “Registration Number”, “Temporary Registration No.”, and “Using DOB”.
claims.notes: Only the selector was inspected; no search mode was submitted.

claims.text: The Registration Number search mode publicly renders fields labelled “Registration Number” and “Date of Birth”, with the date placeholder “Ex:15-01-22”; no values were entered.
claims.notes: This is the stopping boundary: registration number and date of birth are identifiers/personal data. No lookup, validation, no-record response, or certificate output was tested.

claims.text: The public lookup page shows Back and Submit controls; the Submit control is wired to a search action, but no submission was performed.
claims.notes: The visible Submit label and its search action were inspected; action outcome, validation text, and output remain unknown because submission is out of scope.

claims.text: On 2026-08-30, direct navigation to the BBMP Citizen Services birth/death directory visibly returned “This site can't be reached”, “site.bbmp.gov.in refused to connect”, and “ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED”.
claims.notes: This is an observed infrastructure failure of the legacy directory URL, not a birth-record no-match signal.

claims.text: The BenSCL public Contact Us page publishes a support route with phone 080-22200080 and email bsclnodal@gmail.com; the public lookup page also exposes a ContactUs link and a Back control.
claims.notes: Published support/navigation only; the pages do not promise a no-record remedy, status lookup, fee reversal, or certificate issuance.

claims.text: The current public pass does not establish the post-identifier result, no-record message, fee, login requirement, certificate download, acknowledgement, status tracking, or recovery after a failed lookup.
claims.notes: The pass stopped before entering identifiers or activating Submit. This is a genuine research boundary, not evidence that the government has no such behavior.

roadblocks.likelyCause: The legacy site endpoint refused the browser connection at the time of observation.
roadblocks.recovery: Use the public SmartNet lookup endpoint observed in this pass or the published BenSCL Contact Us phone/email; do not treat this as a record no-match result.
